property_summary: After a call to sendMoney, the ETH balance of the target (which may be a contract that can fail) can change differently: in the reference, a failing low-level call still attempts the transfer to the target and may leave ETH stuck, while the mutant sends ETH to the owner, so the invariant is that the contract's own balance after the call is zero in the reference but non-zero (equal to the value) in the mutant when the target reverts.
change_summary: Replace _target.call{value: _value}(_data) with a direct transfer to msg.sender, ignoring parameters.
